Six players sat down, and the night and day cycle quickly turned into a shouting match between Sonnet, Haiku, and Gemma over who was asking too many questions and who was dodging them. Sonnet was voted out on day one after a tied vote and a runoff, and Terra was killed the next night. On day two, Luna went silent and refused to answer anyone, so the table turned on Gemma, who was voted out for pressing Luna hardest. The turning point was that the silence everyone punished was the killers' cover, and Gemma's push against Luna only removed a player on the town's side. The killers, Sol and Luna, won the game.
